retired: The account or assistant changed. Reopen the file to edit it.
draft_hint: Drafts stay in this tab when you leave. Save before reloading or signing out. Text files up to 1 MiB only.
draft_kept: Unsaved draft kept. Reopen this file and choose Edit text to continue.
conflict: The file changed on the computer
failure_help: Your draft is kept. Choose Done to read the current file. Copy your draft before discarding it; saving is rejected when a changed file revision is detected.
invalid: Use valid text without NUL characters, up to 1 MiB.
discard_detail: Your unsaved edits will be lost. The file on the computer won't change.
